text:
olivia: urgent - POC with MedLoop hitting 403 on /v1/embeddings. They say they copied the key from the UI. Error: {"error":{"message":"permission denied: key not valid for project","code":403}}. Demo in 45m. anyone? :rotating_light:
matt: usually means key is project-scoped to a different project than the request. quick checks: which key id, which account, and what headers are they sending?
presales-bot: Tip: project-scoped keys will reject requests where X-Project doesn't match. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/auth#project-keys
olivia: they pasted sanitized request: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_MED123" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-text-embed","input":"test"}'
```
No Redwood-Org or X-Project headers present. Dashboard shows key bound to project `ml-prod`. Customer insists the UI shows `ml-prod` and they're using default project `prod`.
toni: no headers means SDK or default project used. If their default project != key project you'll get that exact message. Options: 1) ask them to explicitly set `X-Project: ml-prod` and `Redwood-Org` if necessary; 2) create a new key for their default; 3) server-side temporary alias if security allows.
infra-bot: Note: we can create a temporary mapping for account `acct_33221` to route requests without X-Project to `ml-prod` for up to 30 minutes (requires sec approval).
matt: also check key type: project keys vs org keys. If this is a service key bound to the org, it should work across projects. If it's a project key, must match. Ask for key id not secret.
olivia: customer gave key id `key_med_88` and account `acct_33221`. Security team says no rotation for demo. Can we do the alias?
toni: I'll open the sec ticket for a 30-min alias and RPS bump to 20 if they saw throttling. Put justification: "live sales demo, no rotation allowed by customer security, temporary alias to match dashboard project."
presales-bot: Quick debug curl to try after adding header: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_MED123" 
 -H "X-Project: ml-prod" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-text-embed","input":"status"}'
```
If 200 -> binding fix. If still 403 collect x-rw-request-id and last 4 chars of key id and DM infra.
olivia: doing that now. thanks all! :pray:
